attributes.action: Ban the public sale of traditional fireworks
attributes.additional_details: Fireworks are regularly misused around Bonfire Night, including in vandalism, violence and attacks on emergency workers. Their unpredictable use despite current time restrictions also causes distress to pets, autistic people and others with sensory sensitivities, particularly when used late at night. Misuse can cause devastating burns, injuries and life-changing damage to hands and limbs. Organised displays offer a safer alternative.
attributes.background: Ban the sale and supply of fireworks to the general public, restricting their use to licensed, organised public displays and other authorised events. This would reduce injuries, violence and attacks on emergency workers, while protecting animals and people affected by unpredictable fireworks.

rejection.details:
We have just opened a petition on the subject of banning private sale and use of fireworks, so they can be used only at licensed displays. You may wish to sign this.

Ban the sale and use of fireworks to the general public
